requiredEvidence.description: Existing strategy unit tests pass without behavior changes.
Manifest name, defaults, exported strategyEntries, and runtime adapter shape remain equivalent.
Continuous execution matches initial history plus next-candle restoration, including pending confirmation.
Repeated evaluation of the same closed candle does not advance detector state twice.
Trade identities, directions, timestamps, figures, and economics match the frozen baseline.
Local AI gate decisions, quality, and rejection reasons match the frozen baseline.
The strategy builds without source access to another strategy directory.
